content: Consolidated whole-epic review found global serialization and brittle implicit instrumentation because concurrency and test seams were not scoped to owned identities. Validate capacity and exactly-once mutation boundaries before closing.
Erasure disconnected before durable deletion without an admission tombstone, leaving a reconnect window. MUST-CHECK: serialize delete lifecycle with every challenge/auth/register admission path.

Recursive extension copy crossed the owned-runtime boundary and imported dependency symlinks, which the world auditor correctly rejected. MUST-CHECK: generated browser fixtures include only explicit runtime files and contain no symlinks.

Mix writes run-scoped lock and PubSub coordination files directly under TMPDIR, outside individual world manifests. MUST-CHECK: final cleanup accounts for framework-owned run residue without weakening root ownership or arbitrary-path protections.
